verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs say nothing run locally ever leaves the machine and that prompts are never tracked or trained on, so in local mode the user implicitly controls retention by owning the data. However, there is no documented retention policy or deletion control for prompts, conversation history, or Ollama Cloud usage. Missing for 10: documented retention periods for cloud requests, explicit user-facing deletion controls for prompts/history/account data, and independent verification of the no-tracking claim.
